content.text: Digital creators in regions with [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/why-payment-infrastructure-south-asian-creators-keeps-failing-2|COREMERCH guide to payment]] restrictions face significant challenges in [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/setting-up-nowpayments-digital-store-step-step-deployment-7|setting]] up their online stores. Platforms like Stripe or PayPal are often unavailable, leaving many without viable options for accepting payments. This guide examines how to deploy Supabase as the order database for your digital store, ensuring you can accept crypto payments without relying on conventional payment processors. Using the Sovereign Blueprint, you can implement Stack 01 in just 4-6 hours, allowing you to regain control over your commerce [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-bitcoin-payments-digital-downloads-stripe-3|The Full]] quickly.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

When traditional payment platforms fail or are inaccessible, the need for a sovereign infrastructure becomes paramount. By leveraging tools like Supabase, GitHub Pages, and NOWPayments, you create an architecture that operates independently of conventional payment barriers. This setup not only supports various cryptocurrencies but also guarantees that you maintain full control over your data and transactions. Unlike conventional platforms, this model is built to endure financial isolation, making it ideal for creators in regions impacted by currency instability or payment restrictions.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital store, ensure you have the necessary accounts and tools in place. Start by creating a GitHub account for hosting your site. Next, set up a Google account to access Google Apps Script for backend logic. For your order database, create a Supabase project. Finally, register with NOWPayments to handle crypto transactions. Each of these components is essential for a seamless deployment process, allowing you to manage payments, product delivery, and order tracking effectively. Make sure you have your digital products ready for upload to streamline the deployment.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

After establishing your accounts, focus on setting up the payment and delivery pipeline. Begin by configuring NOWPayments to accept your chosen cryptocurrencies, ensuring you understand the transaction fee structure. Next, use Google Apps Script to manage incoming orders and communicate with Supabase. This script will automate order processing and product delivery, ensuring buyers receive their digital products immediately upon payment confirmation. Test your pipeline with sample transactions to ensure everything runs smoothly before going live. This step is crucial for a reliable customer experience.
Sovereign infrastructure grants you full ownership and control over your digital store.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

With your infrastructure set up, it's time to go live. Deploy your GitHub Pages site to make it accessible to the public. Announce your store on social media and to your existing audience to drive traffic. Monitor the performance of your payment pipeline closely during the first few transactions. Confirm that payments are being processed efficiently and that customers receive their products without delay. This phase is essential for building trust with your buyers and ensuring your infrastructure performs as expected under real-world conditions.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your store is live and functioning well, consider how to scale your operations. Start by adding more products to your Supabase database, as it supports a broad range of digital goods. Utilize analytics to understand customer behavior and optimize your offerings accordingly. If you're seeing growth, consider transitioning to Stack 02, the Edge Commerce Stack, which provides additional features like enhanced delivery systems and advanced security configurations. This scalability ensures that as your business grows, your infrastructure remains robust and reliable.

The difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 is not which one works — both work — it is which one fits your situation. Stack 01 is the right choice if you want to deploy yourself, you are comfortable with Google Workspace tools, and your initial volume is under 100 orders per day. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete Stack 01 build with full source code and step-by-step configuration. Stack 02 is the right choice if you want the deployment done for you, you need higher volume capacity, or you want email deliverability infrastructure configured from day one. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy Stack 02 under your accounts in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Stack 01 can be deployed in just 4-6 hours, allowing for rapid setup.

This guide connects to related searches, particularly how to use Cloudflare Pages and Workers with Supabase. For those looking for a comprehensive solution, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which is fully deployed in 48 hours and includes enhanced features for your digital store at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

You can build a digital store using GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend processing, and NOWPayments for handling crypto payments. This setup is cost-effective and allows for complete control over your commerce infrastructure.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 utilizes GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script for deployment, taking 4-6 hours. In contrast, Stack 02 is built on Cloudflare Pages and Workers, deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours, with advanced features for order management.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages are excellent options for hosting your digital product store. They offer reliable performance and can integrate seamlessly with backend tools like Supabase and NOWPayments.
How do I integrate NOWPayments into my digital store?

Integrating NOWPayments involves registering for an account, setting up your payment preferences, and connecting it to your order processing logic via Google Apps Script. This ensures automated payment verification and product delivery.
What kind of digital products can I sell with this setup?

You can sell a wide range of digital products, including ebooks, courses, templates, software, and more. The infrastructure supports various file types, allowing you to cater to different customer needs.
With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies without KYC requirements.
